preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n-1 and at most the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 200,000.
The value of k must be between 1 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 400.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= w <= 10**9 and x != y for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range and have a positive weight.

postconditions.description: The output must be the k-th smallest shortest path length.
